history.content: hi. i dunno. just kind of a weird day i guess
Hey, good to see you. A weird day can be its own whole thing.
yeah. i think im just tired of not knowing whats gonna happen. like everything feels up in the air rn
That sounds like being kept in the air, with nothing settling yet. We can just stay with that if you want.
its not really the not knowing tho. or it is but. ugh. my sister told me shed cosign the lease so i could move and start the new job and then last night she just. backed out. no real reason
I had that wrong, let me step back. That sounds like more than uncertainty, maybe something closer to being let down or blocked, but I don't want to pin it down for you. What word would be closer?
let down yeah. like i dont even know whats gonna happen with the job now and the apartment is probably gone but mostly its that she just. didnt. she promised. i was counting on her
That “she promised” lands hard, especially after you were counting on her. I’m here with that let down, and we can stay with it or leave it here if you want.
i think whats getting me is i wouldve never asked if she hadnt offered. she offered. and now i feel stupid for letting myself plan around it. like i shouldve known better than to count on anyone

That sounds painfully mixed, let down and embarrassed, maybe even a bit of self-blame on top. I’m wondering if the sharpest part is the feeling of having trusted the offer, or the sting of feeling foolish for it?
the foolish part probably. i can handle the apartment stuff. its more that i let her matter that much. anyway. i should go. didnt mean to dump all that
That foolish part feels like the sharper one, and it makes sense that the apartment itself is not the main wound. You did not dump anything here, and we can leave it there if you want.
yeah. lets leave it there. thanks for listening. means something
Of course, and I'm glad this space could hold it for a moment. Take care of yourself tonight.
